slides.html: Carry proven baselines from track to track.

slides.label: The problem
slides.html:
Every event, back to square one?

Without a record, practice goes on finding a setup you've already found before.

  • What did we run here last time?
  • What did we change for the cold?

slides.label: Log it
slides.html:
Every session, saved with the reasoning.

Axle, bumpers, brakes and engine. Tap through each part of the kart and save the setup you ran.

slides.label: Take it with you
slides.html:
Every session becomes a report.

Setup, conditions, pressures and lap times on one page.

Export it as a PDF and start the next event from a setup you trust.
